title: merge queue red (Test UI) since 3cc45cc4 (#28150): the app-shell flow-value-envelope pin still lists the ledger's value slots without `connector_action:input.*`
body:
triage#1 · os-zhuang · session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U

Merge-queue-red anchor card, filed by triage. ⛔ Not a claim.

## Red

- **Runs:** merge-queue `CI` for PR #28131 (`e2c96b3c`, run `41079610849`, `Test UI (9/16)`) and for PR #28116 (`6620a9bc`, run `41080050426`, `Test UI (3/16)`). Each fails exactly 1 test of about 5,550, the same one in both runs.
- **Deterministic.** `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/flow-value-envelope.test.ts:77` pins the spec ledger's whole `value`-role list (`FLOW_NODE_EXPRESSION_PATHS`). PR #28150 (#27968), which landed as `3cc45cc4` at 15:18Z, added the `connector_action` row `input.*` (block `connectorConfig`). The received list now carries `connector_action:input.*`; the pin does not.
- **Why main reads green:** main pushes since `3cc45cc4` skip the `Test UI` shards, because those pushes changed no `ui/` input. So every queued PR that touches `ui/` is ejected on this pin, and the next scheduled full run goes red on main too. Main-push green on `3cc45cc4`, `a3d24c99`, `412908cf` and `c48cd2c1` is not evidence.

## Stop-bleed (the only scope)

- Add `'connector_action:input.*'` to the expected list at `flow-value-envelope.test.ts:77`, in sorted position after `'assignment:assignments.*'`. This is a deliberate pin flip, not a skip. The ledger row is correct on `main`, and the pin is what is stale.
- Before pushing, run the whole `ui/packages/app-shell` suite. The other ledger readers are `flowValueSlots-12101.test.tsx`, `flowValueSlots-12372.test.tsx` and `previews/flow-node-refs.ts`. Flip any other pin on the same list in the same PR.
- ⛔ No behaviour change. The Studio readers honouring the `connectorConfig` block root is #28164 (p2), not this card.

## Reader who acts

`domain:ui` (`ui/packages/app-shell`), or the seat that landed #28150 (`domain:spec#1`, os-tesla) under the main-red anchor exception. Under #27047 item 6, a lane claims it this round. If it is unclaimed for one round, triage escalates by name. If it is still unclaimed after that, triage dispatches this stop-bleed.
